title: Don't waste your money
text: Don't waste your money. This stool is too small for any adult to really use. If you are buying for a child it may be perfect. Will never buy again!!!

product_metadata.title: Edeco Modern Round Ottoman Foot Rest Stool/Seat Pouf Ottoman with Linen Fabric and Non-Skid Wooden Legs (Grey)
